name: Hologram Model Hub
about: Open models, every byte named by its hash. Fetch anything by address and check it yourself.
find: read objects[<owner>/<name>] in the catalog; server search needs a publisher token

addresses.files: sha256 of the file bytes, listed in the model object

kinds.model-hub.catalog: today's browse rows, plus objects: { <model id>: { model: <address>, sources: [<address>] } }, plus prev
kinds.model-hub.model: one revision of one model: id, revision, license, files[{path,size,sha256}], prev
kinds.model-hub.source: one place the bytes of one revision can be fetched: ipfs, http or hologram (chunks on any Hologram Server)
